title: Depth-zero circuit class equivalence
statement: For every language $L$ of Boolean strings, $L$ is recognized by a well-formed family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits of polynomial size and depth bounded by a constant times $(\log_2 n+1)^0$ exactly when it is recognized by a family of Boolean circuit trees with polynomial size and depth bounded by a constant times $(\log_2 n+1)^0$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of Boolean strings
